body: I rush to the back door, my heart pounding, and slam it shut behind me, hoping to create a barrier between myself and the unknown. My mind racing with thoughts of danger, I quicken my pace to the front door, preparing for any possibility. I grab my phone, ready to call the police if needed, and step out onto the porch, scanning the yard for any sign of the dog or the object it has cornered.
